Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1353
Claimant:
Justin Middleton
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
August 1, 2024
Insured reported a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection and stated the claimant's vehicle was stopped in
front of them at the time of impact. Claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact has been routed
through the attorney's office.
August 2, 2024
Photos submitted by the insured show the rear bumper, tail lamp assembly, and trunk lid damage, which is largely
consistent with the impact described. No independent witnesses have come forward at this stage.
September 28, 2024
Claimant's attorney provided the initial injury notice, reporting a concussion diagnosed at the emergency department.
The reported injury appears consistent with the kind and force of a collision of this type.
October 2, 2024
Reviewed the prior-records request. No earleir injury to the same body area is on file, and no prior claims inovlving
the claimant's vehicle have been identified.
October 13, 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the account given in the first notice. The claimant has described
the events the same way in each conversation so far.
October 31, 2024
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for a concussoin of this severity, and the treating
physician's notes explain the extended follow-up. Requested updated records to confirm the current plan of care.
November 6, 2024
Claimant's seating position at the moment of impact is still not fully clear from the statements so far. Following up with
the attorney to clarify before any evaluation is finalized.
November 15, 2024
Confirmed with the insured that the driver involved is not listed on the policy and does not reside with the
policyholder. Coverage questions are being reviewed under the policy terms.
January 1, 2025
Reviewed the vehicle repair estimate and the inspection notes. Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred
before the policy's effective date, and no earlier damage to the vehicle has been identified.
January 15, 2025
File remains open pending the updated mediacl records, the outstanding seating-position clarification, and a final
coverage determination on the driver's status.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
